Name: Marriageable Candidate Pajamas
Author: GabbyCraft
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Gives the 12 marriage candidates pajamas! Can also toggle which characters wear or do not wear pajamas, and the times of day that they wear them. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip the file and place it in your mods folder. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. [/color][/size]

Downloads.Description: Works best in if you have no other portrait or sprite editing mods that affect these characters. Compatibility with the Seasonal Outfits Mod is still WIP.

Manifest.Name: SDVCandidatePajamas
Manifest.Description: Gives pajamas to the marriagable candidates! They will only wear these when inside their home (or your home if you're married to them).
Manifest.Author: GabbyCraft
